test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following options is NOT correctly matched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sardar Sarovar Lake - Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sardar Sarovar Lake is actually located in** Gujarat,** not Karnataka.
 
• It is part of the Sardar Sarovar Dam project on the **Narmada River.**
 
• The dam is one of the largest in India and provides water and electricity to multiple states.
 
• The project has been a subject of environmental and social debates.
 
• The** Sardar Sarovar Dam project** involves four major states:
 
 
• **Gujarat:** The dam is located in Gujarat and provides water and electricity to the state.
 
• **Madhya Pradesh:** Receives water for irrigation and drinking purposes.
 
• **Maharashtra:** Benefits from the water supply for irrigation and other uses.
 
• **Rajasthan:** Also receives water for irrigation and drinking purposes
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chilika Lake - Odisha**: Chilika Lake is the** largest coastal lagoon in India** and the second largest in the world. It is located in the state of Odisha and is known for its rich biodiversity and as a habitat for migratory birds.
 
• **Wular Lake - Jammu and Kashmir**: Wular Lake is one of the largest freshwater lakes in Asia, located in the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir. It plays a significant role in the hydrography of the Kashmir Valley.
 
• **Vembanad Lake - Kerala**: Vembanad Lake is the** longest lake in India **and the largest lake in the state of Kerala. It is known for its scenic beauty and is a major tourist attraction.
 
• **Statue of Unity**: The Statue of Unity is the** world’s tallest statue**, standing at 182 meters (597 feet). It is located near** Kevadia in Gujarat** and depicts Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, an Indian statesman and independence activist. The statue was inaugurated on October 31, 2018, and is a major tourist attraction.
